It's #PrideMonth! I've briefly talked about this on stream, I'm not very open about my sexual orientation and love life, but heck. This is my first open Pride month so lets go: I identify as both Asexual and Biromantic.

So here is my story: In my last relationship whenever we talked about sexual things, something didn't feel right for me. I often avoided subjects and I feel like that was our downfall. I felt odd, like I was different. I felt broken and it contributed to my depression.

I do like men a lot more than I like woman, but if the right woman were to come along, heck. Then I learnt that it was ok to be Asexual and Biromantic ~ to love both genders in a romantic way, but want nothing sexual with them.
So that's me! I'm Asexual and Biromantic! I also saw this lovely graphic in a post by explaining what Asexual is. (She's a lovely woman, go check her out!) Happy #PRIDE month everybody! 🏳️‍🌈💜🖤🤍
